テキスト cha 778: Ito's form as one with Shigatsu Youka, the smallest tree in the Arata settlement. It has been her usual form since she was mortally wounded in Shiyo 5. Its hyphae wind around her whole body, and she cannot leave it. Unlike Sakura and Eiichiro Niimura she is alive, so she keeps her lower body, buried in the trunk. Her nervous system is as it was in life, so she and Shigatsu Youka share control of it; the slightest discord between their minds sends her whole body into convulsions. But her aging has stopped: while one with it, she will never die of old age. Once every few hundred years―when Shigatsu Youka is spent or badly damaged―she can be cut off and live as an ordinary human, aging like one. Directly beneath the tree lies the mycelial mat at Shigatsu Youka's core.

Normally Ito cannot move her body freely in this form, but through her talk with Natsumi Kogori, a gap opened between her will and Shigatsu Youka's for the first time. These violent convulsions mean that Shigatsu Youka's will and Ito's will are in fierce conflict (normally no such convulsions are seen). So, answering Natsumi's call, she defies Shigatsu Youka's will and shows Natsumi the events of the past and what she herself wants.

To revive the Prince, Shigatsu Youka's hyphae had to be extended to Motoki-cho, which took more than 700 years, and raising the goshinboku to turn the soil into ground where Shigatsu Youka could grow on its own took about 70 years. She originally meant to wait longer, until Motoki-cho's population grew, to gain 'fertilizer' to enrich the soil, but because her existence became known, she hurriedly decided to move in Shiyo 800.

In response to Natsumi Kogori's call, Ito's will surfaces strongly and the control over her weakens. Seizing that opening, Ito tells Natsumi, 'Please destroy Shigatsu Youka.' Natsumi and the others use third-generation blood, and Shigatsu Youka is destroyed.
